steps: Using unit vector formula a-hat = a/|a|

solved.q: Find the position vector of the point P which divides the join of A(2,3,4) and B(4,5,6) internally in the ratio 2:3.
steps: Using section formula P = (m*b + n*a)/(m+n) for ratio m:n = 2:3

solved.q: Show that the points A(1,-1,2), B(3,3,8) and C(5,7,14) are collinear.
steps: Since AC is a scalar multiple of AB, AB and AC are parallel and share point A
Hence A, B, C are collinear
solved.ans: A, B, C are collinear since AC = 2 AB

solved.topic: Area of a triangle using cross product
solved.q: Find the area of the triangle with vertices A(1,1,1), B(2,3,1) and C(3,1,2).
steps: Find AB = B - A = (1,2,0) and AC = C - A = (2,0,1)
Using cross product AB x AC = |i j k; 1 2 0; 2 0 1|
Area of triangle = (1/2)|AB x AC| = sqrt(21)/2

solved.topic: Area of a parallelogram using cross product
solved.q: Find the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are a = 2i - 3j + k and b = i + j - 2k.
steps: Using cross product a x b = |i j k; 2 -3 1; 1 1 -2|
Area of parallelogram = |a x b| = 5 sqrt(3)

solved.q: Show that the vectors a = i - 2j + 3k, b = 2i + j - k and c = -5j + 7k are coplanar.
steps: Vectors are coplanar iff the scalar triple product [a b c] = 0
Since the scalar triple product is 0, the vectors a, b, c are coplanar

solved.topic: Projection of one vector on another
solved.q: Find the projection of a = i + 2j + 2k on b = 3i - 4j.
steps: Using projection of a on b = (a.b)/|b|

solved.topic: Unit vector perpendicular to two given vectors
solved.q: Find the unit vector perpendicular to both a = i + j + k and b = i + 2j + 3k.
steps: A vector perpendicular to both a and b is given by cross product a x b
Using unit vector = (a x b)/|a x b|
Required unit vector = (1/sqrt(6)) i - (2/sqrt(6)) j + (1/sqrt(6)) k
